title: Register stores a bcrypt hash and opens a session
steps: POST /api/auth/register {name,email,password}; read users + sessions in DB
expected: 201 {accessToken,user}; Set-Cookie rt HttpOnly SameSite=Strict; users.passwordHash starts with $2 and is not the plain password; one session row with tokenHash
proves: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and logins are tracked server-side (advanced requirement: bcrypt)

title: Duplicate email is rejected
steps: Register the same email twice (different case)
expected: Second call 409 EMAIL_TAKEN
proves: Unique index + lower-casing + E11000 → 409 mapping in the error middleware

title: Wrong password and unknown email look the same
steps: Login with wrong password; login with unknown email
expected: Both 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS with identical message
proves: No user enumeration through the login form

title: Protected routes need a valid JWT
steps: GET /api/wallets with no token, a tampered token, an expired token
expected: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED
proves: requireAuth verifies signature and expiry (advanced requirement: JWT)

title: Refresh rotates the token and detects reuse
steps: Login; POST /auth/refresh with cookie A → cookie B; POST /auth/refresh again with old cookie A
expected: First refresh 200 + new cookie; reuse of A → 401 and every session of the user revoked (B also fails)
proves: Refresh-token rotation and stolen-token reuse detection work

title: Logout revokes the session
steps: Login; POST /auth/logout; POST /auth/refresh with the same cookie
expected: Logout 204, cookie cleared; refresh 401 INVALID_REFRESH
proves: Logout is real (server-side), not just deleting a token in the browser

title: Login is rate-limited
steps: 11 failed logins from one IP within 15 min
expected: 11th call 429
proves: Basic brute-force protection is active

title: Register, reload, logout in a real browser
steps: Register via UI → dashboard; reload page; click Logout; open /transactions
expected: Still logged in after reload; after logout redirected to /login
proves: AuthContext + silent refresh + ProtectedRoute work together (state requirement: Context for login)

title: Locked user cannot log in
steps: Admin sets userB status=locked; userB logs in
expected: 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED
proves: Account status is enforced at login

title: Log out other devices
steps: Login on device 1 and 2; device 1 calls DELETE /sessions?others=true; device 2 refreshes
expected: 204; device 2 refresh 401; device 1 still works
proves: Session list and selective revocation work

title: Wallet CRUD uses correct methods and codes
steps: POST, GET list, GET one, PATCH, DELETE /api/wallets
expected: 201, 200, 200, 200, 204; list no longer shows the deleted wallet
proves: REST design: right HTTP method and status code for each action

title: User B cannot touch user A's wallet
steps: As userB: GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/wallets/<userA wallet id>
expected: 404 for all three; userA's wallet unchanged in DB
proves: Every query is scoped by userId (no data leaks by guessing IDs)

title: Wallet in use cannot be deleted
steps: Create confirmed transaction on wallet; DELETE wallet
expected: 409 WALLET_IN_USE
proves: Relations between collections are protected in the app layer

title: Balance counts only confirmed, non-deleted transactions
steps: initial 100k; +income 50k; expense 30k; draft expense 20k; deleted expense 10k; GET /api/wallets
expected: balance = 120000
proves: Balance aggregation is correct

title: Wallet card updates after adding a transaction
steps: Create wallet in UI; quick add 'cafe 30k mm'; open Wallets
expected: Balance drops by 30,000 without manual refresh
proves: RTK Query tag invalidation keeps screens in sync (Redux Toolkit requirement)

title: Defaults are seeded on register
steps: Register; GET /api/categories?type=expense and income; GET /api/wallets
expected: All template categories present with vi/en names and keywords; 'Tiền mặt' default wallet
proves: New users can start immediately; templates are copied, not shared

title: Category CRUD + validation
steps: POST with empty name; POST valid; PATCH keywords; DELETE
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; 201; 200; 204
proves: zod validation and CRUD for categories

title: Deleting a category keeps its transactions
steps: Category with 3 transactions → DELETE; delete fallback 'Khác'
expected: 204 and the 3 transactions now point to fallback; deleting fallback → 409 FALLBACK_CATEGORY
proves: No orphaned transactions after delete

title: Keyword input strips diacritics
steps: Type 'Phở Bò' into keyword chips
expected: Chip saved as 'pho bo'
proves: UI normalises keywords the same way the parser matches them

title: Create a transaction from the web
steps: POST /api/transactions valid body
expected: 201; status=confirmed; source=web
proves: Basic create path and defaults

title: Only positive integer VND amounts
expected: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for each
proves: Money is always a safe positive integer (no float errors)

title: Cannot use someone else's wallet or category
steps: As userA POST with userB's walletId
proves: Ownership is checked on referenced documents too

title: Filters and pagination
steps: Seed 45 tx; GET with from/to, type, walletId, categoryId, status, q, page=2&limit=20
expected: Correct subset; {page:2, limit:20, total:N}; sorted newest first
proves: Search, filter and pagination work (topic requirement: statistics/history)

title: Soft delete and restore
steps: DELETE tx; GET list and stats; POST /restore
expected: Hidden from list and stats; deletedAt set in DB; restore brings it back
proves: Soft delete keeps data recoverable and stats consistent

title: Add, edit, delete with undo in the UI
steps: Open dialog → add; edit amount; delete → click Undo
expected: Table updates each time; Undo restores row
proves: Full CRUD works for a customer in the browser

title: Month boundaries use Vietnam time
expected: First counts in November, second in December
proves: Server running in UTC still groups by Vietnamese calendar

title: Budget CRUD and one-per-month rule
steps: POST budget Ăn uống 2026-11; POST same again; PATCH limit; DELETE
expected: 201; 409 BUDGET_EXISTS; 200; 204
proves: Unique compound index and CRUD (topic requirement: monthly budget)

title: Spent and percent are computed correctly
steps: Limit 1,000,000; confirmed expenses 450k+300k; one draft 100k
expected: spent 750000, percent 75
proves: Budget usage ignores drafts and other categories

title: Budget warning at 80% and 100%
steps: Confirm expense crossing 80%, then 100%
expected: Response has budgetWarning; bot message contains warning line in user's language
proves: Budget alerts reach both web and chat

title: Progress colours and copy last month
steps: Budgets at 50%, 90%, 120%; click Copy from last month
expected: Green, amber, red bars with text labels; budgets copied with 201
proves: Budget screen is readable and convenient

title: Month summary equals hand-computed fixture
steps: Seed fixture; GET /api/stats/summary?month=2026-11
expected: income/expense/net exactly as expected-stats.json
proves: Aggregation pipeline is correct (topic requirement: statistics)

title: By-category percentages
steps: GET /api/stats/by-category?month=2026-11
expected: Totals match fixture; percents sum to 100 (±1 rounding)
proves: Pie chart data is consistent

title: Daily trend grouped by Vietnam date
steps: Seed transactions around midnight VN; GET /api/stats/daily
expected: Each lands on its VN date
proves: $dateToString uses timezone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh

title: Dashboard charts and month switch
steps: Open dashboard; switch month
expected: Cards and charts update; each chart has a text summary
proves: Statistics are visible and accessible

title: Generate a link code
steps: POST /api/chat-links/code
expected: 201 {code (6 chars), expiresAt +10 min, telegramDeepLink}; DB stores only codeHash
proves: Link codes are short-lived and never stored in plain text

title: Codes are single-use and expire
steps: Telegram '/start CODE' → linked; reuse CODE from another chat; use an expired code
expected: chatLinks row created once; reuse and expired both get 'invalid code' reply
proves: Account linking is safe against replay

title: One chat account maps to one web account
steps: Chat already linked to userA tries userB's code
expected: Reply explains it is already linked; no second row
proves: Unique index (platform, platformUserId)

title: Unlink
steps: DELETE /api/chat-links/:id; send a message from that chat
expected: 204; bot replies 'please link your account'
proves: Unlinking stops the bot acting for the user

title: Telegram deep link in one tap
steps: Bot inbox → Generate code → open deep link on phone
expected: Bot says 'Đã liên kết'; Bot inbox lists the Telegram account
proves: Real Telegram linking works

title: Parser rule table
steps: Run every row of docs/02-features.md §2.5 (45k, 1tr2, 1.5tr, 150.000, +lương 15tr, hôm qua, mm alias, coffee 30k…)
expected: Exact {type, amount, category, wallet, date, note} for each row
proves: Rule-based parsing works without any AI

title: Parser edge cases
steps: 'abc', '', 12 lines, '45' (bare), '1tr25'
expected: null for no amount; only first 10 lines; 45000; 1250000
proves: Bad input never creates a wrong transaction

title: Webhook secret is required
steps: POST /api/webhooks/telegram and /zalo without or with wrong secret header
expected: 401; nothing written to DB; no message sent
proves: Nobody can fake chat messages

title: Telegram text → draft with buttons
steps: POST recorded Telegram update 'phở 45k' from linked chat
expected: 200 immediately; draft {expense 45000 Ăn uống source telegram}; sendMessage called with inline keyboard
proves: Telegram capture flow

title: Duplicate delivery creates one draft
steps: POST the same update twice
expected: Exactly one draft (unique chatRef index)
proves: Retries from Telegram/Zalo don't double-count money

title: Telegram confirm and cancel buttons
steps: callback_query c:<id>; x:<id2>; c:<id of another user's draft>
expected: Confirmed; soft-deleted; ignored with 'not found'
proves: Buttons act only on the sender's own drafts

title: Zalo text with ok/huy
steps: Zalo 'grab 32k' → reply 'ok'; second draft → 'huy'
expected: Draft confirmed via pendingTransactionId; second discarded
proves: Zalo flow works without buttons

title: Zalo photo → KIE → draft
steps: message.image.received with photo_url; KIE mocked with recorded /analyze response
expected: 'Đang đọc hoá đơn…' sent; draft amount = total digits; receipt.items saved
proves: Photo pipeline and KIE mapping

title: KIE down or slow
steps: KIE mock returns network error; then delays 130 s (fake timers)
expected: Friendly 'couldn't read receipt, type the amount' message; no draft
proves: Failures are handled gracefully, no AI fallback

title: Unlinked chat
steps: Text from unknown chat
expected: Reply with link instructions; nothing stored
proves: Bot never writes data without a linked account

title: /today and /month
steps: Seed data; send /today, /month in vi then /lang en
expected: Totals match stats API; text in the chosen language
proves: Bot queries reuse the statistics service

title: Real Telegram capture on Vercel
steps: Send 'phở 45k' to @sochitieu_btl_bot → ✅
expected: Appears on web dashboard within seconds; webhook 200 in Vercel logs
proves: Works on the deployed system, not just in tests

title: Real Zalo capture on Vercel
steps: Send 'grab 32k' to the Zalo bot → 'ok'
expected: Saved; first real payload logged and matches expected fields
proves: Zalo payload assumptions are correct

title: Review a draft on the web
steps: Seed a telegram draft; open /bot; change amount; Confirm
expected: Draft disappears from inbox and appears in Transactions with new amount
proves: Drafts from chat can be corrected on the web

title: Confirm twice
steps: POST /transactions/:id/confirm twice
expected: 200 then 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED
proves: Confirm is idempotency-safe

title: Real KIE output maps to a draft
steps: Send the 5 sample images from KIE data/test_degraded to /analyze through our client
expected: Each returns total → integer amount; date parsed or now; merchant as note
proves: Integration works with real OCR output

title: Bad uploads rejected
steps: POST /api/receipts with .pdf; with 6 MB image
proves: Input limits are enforced before calling KIE

title: Phone photo resized in the browser
steps: Upload 8 MB JPEG in /bot
expected: Request body < 4.5 MB; draft created
proves: Works within Vercel's request size limit

title: Admin routes need admin role
steps: As user: GET /api/admin/users
expected: 403 FORBIDDEN
proves: Role-based authorization (advanced requirement: phân quyền)

title: Locking a user revokes their sessions
steps: Admin PATCH /admin/users/:id {status:'locked'}; user refreshes
expected: 200; user refresh 401; login 403
proves: Admin actions take effect immediately

title: Last admin protection
steps: Only admin tries to demote or lock themselves
expected: 409 LAST_ADMIN
proves: The system can't lose its last administrator

title: Template edits affect new users only
steps: Admin adds keyword to template; existing user vs newly registered user
expected: Only the new user's category has the keyword
proves: Templates are copied, users' data is not changed behind their back

title: Admin UI visibility
steps: Login as user: look for Admin menu; open /admin/users directly
expected: No menu; 403 page
proves: AdminRoute guard in the frontend

title: Theme persists
steps: Switch to dark; reload; log out and in on a fresh browser context
expected: Dark after reload (localStorage) and after login (profile)
proves: Light/dark theming requirement

title: Language switch
steps: Switch to English
expected: UI strings English; money shows ₫45,000 style; bot replies switch to English
proves: Bilingual system (vi/en)

title: Translation completeness
steps: Compare keys in vi.json and en.json; every backend error code has errors.<CODE>
expected: No missing keys
proves: No untranslated text slips into the UI

title: Parse preview saves nothing
steps: POST /api/transactions/parse {text:'phở 45k'}
expected: 200 drafts[0] amount 45000; DB transaction count unchanged
proves: Preview endpoint is read-only

title: Type and press Enter
steps: Dashboard quick add 'phở 45k' Enter; then 'abc' Enter
expected: Row appears in latest transactions; 'abc' shows inline error, nothing saved
proves: Customers can track spending on the web without bots

title: Several lines at once
steps: Paste 3 lines into quick add
expected: 3 transactions created
proves: Bulk entry works

title: Type check and lint
steps: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
expected: 0 errors
proves: TypeScript types are consistent across the frontend

title: Responsive layouts
steps: Screenshot every page at 375×812, 768×1024, 1280×800 in light and dark
expected: No horizontal scroll; bottom nav on phone, drawer on desktop
proves: Responsive requirement

title: Accessibility
steps: Run axe on login, dashboard, transactions in both themes
expected: No serious/critical violations
proves: Basic accessibility and contrast in dark mode

title: Injection and XSS
steps: Login with {email:{$gt:''}}; note '' then view it
expected: 400; note shown as text, no script runs
proves: sanitizeFilter + zod + React escaping protect the app

title: No secrets in git
steps: git ls-files | grep -i env; scan history
expected: Only .env.example
proves: Slide rule 5: không lộ .env

title: Deploy smoke
steps: GET /api/health; open /budgets directly and refresh
expected: {status:'ok',db:'up'}; SPA loads (rewrite works)
proves: Vercel + Atlas deployment is healthy (advanced requirement: deploy)

title: Error middleware
steps: GET /api/nope; force an exception in a route
expected: 404 JSON {error:{code:'NOT_FOUND'}}; 500 JSON without stack trace
proves: Slide rule 3: error-handling middleware

title: Latency
steps: Measure list endpoints and one receipt from logs
expected: List p95 < 500 ms; receipt < 60 s end to end
proves: Demo feels responsive

title: First-time customer, web only
steps: Register → quick add 3 lines → dashboard → edit → delete + undo
expected: Cards match DB; no console errors; all /api calls 2xx
proves: A customer can track money on the website without any bot

tool: Phone + Claude in Chrome + Vercel logs
title: Telegram end to end
steps: Link via deep link → 'phở 45k' → ✅ → /today
expected: Confirmed in DB; dashboard updates; webhook 200 < 1 s
proves: Telegram linking and capture on the deployed system

tool: Phone + Claude in Chrome + Vercel logs
title: Zalo end to end
steps: /link CODE → 'grab 32k' → ok → second draft huy
expected: First saved, second soft-deleted
proves: Zalo flow without buttons on the deployed system

title: Receipt photos
steps: Same real receipt via Telegram, Zalo and web; then stop the tunnel and retry
expected: Total matches receipt; clear failure message when KIE is down
proves: KIE integration and graceful failure

title: Phone layout, dark mode, English
steps: Whole app at 375 px; toggle theme and language on every page
expected: No overflow; readable charts; no untranslated strings
proves: Responsive + theming + i18n

title: Admin
steps: Lock userB; edit default category; register userC
expected: userB logged out everywhere; userC gets the edited category
proves: Roles and permissions

title: Security probing
steps: As userB open userA's transaction id; replay old refresh cookie; webhook without secret
expected: 404, 401, 401; DB unchanged
proves: Ownership isolation, token reuse detection, webhook auth

title: Demo rehearsal
steps: Run the full defense demo script on Vercel, timed
expected: < 10 min; zero errors in logs
proves: Ready for the defense

title: Config validation fails fast
steps: parseEnv() in production mode with MONGODB_URI missing, a short JWT_ACCESS_SECRET and an invalid optional TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET; parseEnv() in production mode with only MONGODB_URI and JWT_ACCESS_SECRET; parseEnv() in test mode
expected: Startup error names every missing or invalid variable and never prints a value; bot, KIE, APP_URL and seed variables are optional (empty counts as unset) and checked only when set; test mode fills safe defaults
proves: The API refuses to start without what it truly needs, never leaks secrets into logs, and does not depend on optional integrations

title: Degraded boot
steps: Start server/src/local.js with NODE_ENV=production, only MONGODB_URI (unreachable) and JWT_ACCESS_SECRET; GET /api/health
expected: The API starts listening; health answers 503 {status:'error', db:'down'}; the process keeps running
proves: Missing integration secrets or a down database never stop the API from booting or crash it

title: Update profile and preferences
steps: PATCH /api/users/me {name, language, theme, role, email}; invalid values; defaultWalletId of own, another user's and a deleted wallet; null
expected: 200 with name/language/theme changed and role/email unchanged; invalid values 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; own wallet 200, other user's or deleted wallet 404 NOT_FOUND; null clears it
proves: Users can edit only their own profile fields, and the default wallet must belong to them

title: Change password
steps: Login on laptop and phone; laptop PATCH /api/users/me/password with a wrong, then a too short, then a valid new password; both devices refresh; login with old and new password
expected: Wrong current 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS; short 400; valid 204; phone refresh 401, laptop refresh 200; old password 401, new password 200
proves: A password change needs the current password, is stored as a new bcrypt hash and logs out every other device

title: requireRole('admin') guard
steps: GET a route behind requireAuth + requireRole('admin') as a user, as an admin (fresh token after the role change) and without a token
expected: user 403 FORBIDDEN; admin 200; no token 401
proves: The role claim in the JWT gates admin-only routes

title: Seeding users is idempotent
steps: seedUsers(env) then seedUsers(env, {test:true}) twice; seedUsers({}) with nothing configured; login as the seeded admin
expected: `seed` creates only the admin; `seed:test` adds userA and userB; no duplicates on a second run; missing variables are skipped with a message; the admin logs in with role admin
proves: npm run seed / seed:test can be run on any environment repeatedly without breaking data

title: One shared refresh for parallel expired requests
steps: Three API calls at once answer 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED; refresh succeeds. Then: refresh fails. Then: a 403 that is not TOKEN_EXPIRED
expected: Exactly one POST /api/auth/refresh, all three calls retried with the new token; a failed refresh clears the session; other errors are returned without a refresh
proves: baseQueryWithRefresh never sends two refreshes at once (which the server's rotation would treat as token theft) and logs the user out cleanly when the refresh cookie is no longer valid

title: Login and register forms validate and translate errors
steps: Submit empty/invalid login and register forms; submit wrong credentials, a taken email and a network failure
expected: Translated field errors linked to their inputs, focus on the first invalid field, no request sent; server codes INVALID_CREDENTIALS / EMAIL_TAKEN / NETWORK_ERROR shown in the UI language; a valid register opens the app
proves: Forms give accessible, bilingual feedback and only send valid input to the API

title: Route guards
steps: Anonymous visitor opens a protected page, logs in; logged-in user opens /register; user and admin open an admin page
expected: Visitor goes to /login and back to the page they asked for; logged-in user is sent to /; non-admin sees 403, admin sees the page; admin links only in an admin's navigation
proves: ProtectedRoute and AdminRoute enforce login and role in the UI (the API enforces them too)

title: Template seeding and default data are idempotent
steps: seedCategoryTemplates() twice; onUserRegistered on a registered user; onUserRegistered on a user created without defaults
expected: 13 templates, no duplicates; the registered user keeps 1 wallet and 13 categories; the older user gets the Tiền mặt default wallet and 13 categories
proves: npm run seed can run repeatedly and backfills accounts created before default data existed, without touching admin-edited templates

title: Confirm a draft
steps: Insert a Telegram draft; POST /api/transactions/:id/confirm twice; delete it and confirm again. Insert a draft in a second wallet, delete that wallet, confirm the draft
expected: First 200 {transaction} with status confirmed and the wallet balance now counts it; second 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED; deleted 404; draft in a deleted wallet 404 details walletId not_found and stays a draft
proves: Drafts become real money only once, through the same confirm step the bots use

title: chatRef unique partial index
steps: Create drafts with chatRef telegram/111/7 twice, telegram/222/7, zalo/111/7, and two without chatRef
expected: Second telegram/111/7 fails with E11000; the other five are stored
proves: A retried webhook cannot store a second draft, while other chats and web entries are not limited

title: budgetWarning thresholds
steps: Budget Ăn uống 1,000,000 for 2026-11; confirmed expenses 799,999, then +1, then +250,000; then an overall budget 1,400,000 and a 100,000 Đi lại expense; call budgetWarning(user, category, month) after each step
expected: null below 80 % and without a budget; threshold 80 at exactly 80 %; threshold 100 at 105 %; the overall budget warns for Đi lại (82 %); the fuller budget is reported; other months and users get null
proves: The service the bots (T11) and /confirm use warns exactly at 80 % and 100 % of the category or overall budget

title: setWebhooks registers both bots
steps: setWebhooks('https://demo.example.app/', tokens + secrets) with the Telegram and Zalo setWebhook calls mocked; then with a refused Telegram token and no Zalo variables
expected: Telegram gets {url …/api/webhooks/telegram, secret_token, allowed_updates [message, callback_query]}, Zalo gets {url …/api/webhooks/zalo, secret_token}, both 'ok'; a refusal is reported as 'failed: Unauthorized' and a platform without variables as 'skipped', never printing a token
proves: One command points both bots at a deployment with the secrets the webhooks check, including the ✅/❌ button updates

title: Locked account and the bot
steps: Linked chat makes a draft; the user is locked; send 'grab 32k', 'ok' and press ✅ on the draft
expected: Every reply says the account is locked; no new draft; the old draft stays a draft
proves: An admin lock also stops the bots acting for the user

title: Web receipt upload → draft; KIE errors mapped
steps: POST /api/receipts without a token, without the image field, then with a JPEG (KIE mocked with the recorded /analyze answer); then with KIE down, answering 401 (wrong key), finding no total, refusing the image, and timing out
expected: 401; 400 details image required; 201 {transaction} draft, source 'receipt', amount = total digits, category by keyword, default wallet, receipt items; then 502 KIE_UNAVAILABLE twice, 422 RECEIPT_UNREADABLE twice, 504 KIE_TIMEOUT; only the one draft stored
proves: The web upload uses the same receipt pipeline as the bots, and every KIE failure gets a stable error code the UI can translate
